description: This file contains the implementation of the EmpEmergencyContactDao class, which manages database operations related to employee emergency contacts within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching emergency contact data, leveraging Doctrine query builder and ORM features.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling employee emergency contact records, extending BaseDao to inherit common database operations, focused on CRUD and search functionalities for employee emergency contacts.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Saves an EmpEmergencyContact object to the database, assigning a sequential number if it's new, with validation for the sequence number.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmpEmergencyContact by employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingSeqNosForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the list of existing sequence numbers for a given employee among specified sequence numbers.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Deletes multiple emergency contact records for an employee based on provided sequence numbers.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Retrieves all emergency contacts for a specified employee, ordered by name.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Performs a search for emergency contacts based on filtering parameters with pagination support.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator object for emergency contact search results, applying filters and sorting.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of emergency contacts matching search filter parameters.
